assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations, dizziness, and near-syncope that are intermittent and difficult to capture on standard ambulatory monitoring.
Clinical suspicion of sick sinus syndrome and unspecified cardiac arrhythmia.
Prolonged mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to correlate symptoms with rhythm disturbances over an extended period.
The service addresses the specific diagnostic need for CPT 93229.
The denial is based on reason code CO-197.
